Upload HTML File on Mobile with Tiiny.host or Netlify Drop
User works from an Android phone. They want to upload the site and get a direct link using only their phone. Give simple steps: download file from sandbox link? The file is at sandbox path â€” can they download it? In Kimi chat, the file deliverable can usually be downloaded. I should explain steps on Android: download the file from the chat (the REF file), then use Netlify Drop via Chrome browser (works on mobile), or alternatives like GitHub app, or "tiiny.host" which works from mobile easily. Tiiny.host is very mobile-friendly â€” drag file upload via phone. Also can rename file to index.html.
Key steps:
  1. Download the HTML file to the phone (from the chat attachment).
  2. Rename it to index.html (using Files app).
  3. Go to tiiny.host or app.netlify.com/drop in Chrome, upload file, get link.
Note: Netlify Drop on mobile Chrome can be finicky with drag-drop; tiiny.host has a button upload that works well on mobile. Recommend tiiny.host first.

* { margin: 0px; padding: 0px; box-sizing: border-box; font-family: "Segoe UI", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif; } body { background: rgb(244, 246, 244); color: rgb(44, 62, 53); } a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } :root { --green: #1e6b45; --green-d: #145232; --gold: #c9a227; --gold-l: #e6c455; } header { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--green-d), var(--green)); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 14px 5%; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; position: sticky; top: 0px; z-index: 100; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 0px 3px 15px; } .logo { font-size: 25px; font-weight: bold; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .logo span { color: var(--gold-l); } nav ul { display: flex; list-style: none; gap: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 15px; } nav a:hover { color: var(--gold-l); } .btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #a8841a); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 11px 24px; border-radius: 10px; font-weight: bold; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; cursor: pointer; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.4) 0px 3px 8px; transition: 0.2s; } .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.5) 0px 6px 14px; } .hero { background: linear-gradient(rgba(16, 58, 36, 0.88), rgba(16, 58, 36, 0.88)), url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1484557985045-edf25e08da73?w=1600") center center / cover; padding: 80px 5%; text-align: center; color: rgb(255, 255, 255); } .hero h1 { font-size: 38px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0px 2px 8px; } .hero h1 span { color: var(--gold-l); } .hero p { font-size: 17px; margin-bottom: 28px; opacity: 0.92; } .search-box { display: flex; max-width: 720px; margin: auto; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 8px 30px; } .search-box input, .search-box select { padding: 15px; border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; font-size: 15px; outline: none; } .search-box input { flex: 2 1 0%; } .search-box select { flex: 1 1 0%; border-right: 1px solid rgb(238, 238, 238); } .search-box button { background: var(--gold); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; padding: 0px 32px; font-size: 17px; cursor: pointer; font-weight: bold; } .disclaimer { background: rgb(255, 248, 225); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--gold); padding: 10px 5%; text-align: center; font-size: 14px; color: rgb(122, 101, 18); } .categories { padding: 55px 5%; text-align: center; } .categories h2, .section h2 { font-size: 27px; color: var(--green-d); margin-bottom: 8px; } .sub { color: rgb(136, 136, 136); margin-bottom: 32px; } .cat-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(140px, 1fr)); gap: 18px; max-width: 850px; margin: auto; } .cat-card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 24px 12px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07) 0px 4px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.3s; border: 2px solid transparent; } .cat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12) 0px 10px 25px; } .cat-card .icon { font-size: 42px; margin-bottom: 8px; } .cat-card .count { color: rgb(153, 153, 153); font-size: 13px; margin-top: 4px; } .section { padding: 10px 5% 60px; } .ads-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(270px, 1fr)); gap: 25px; } .ad-card { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09) 0px 4px 14px; transition: 0.3s; border: 1px solid rgb(238, 238, 238); } .ad-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15) 0px 12px 28px; } .ad-media { height: 200px; background: rgb(232, 240, 234); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; position: relative; } .ad-media img, .ad-media video { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } .ad-media .icon { font-size: 70px; } .ad-body { padding: 16px 18px 20px; } .ad-body h3 { color: var(--green-d); font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ad-info { color: rgb(136, 136, 136); font-size: 13.5px; margin-bottom: 4px; } .price { color: var(--gold); font-size: 21px; font-weight: bold; margin: 10px 0px; } .price small { font-size: 14px; color: rgb(168, 132, 26); } .btn-main { font-size: 17px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 12px; } .btn-hero { display: block; margin: 28px auto 0px; font-size: 22px; padding: 18px 45px; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: rgba(201, 162, 39, 0.55) 0px 8px 25px; animation: 2s ease 0s infinite normal none running pulse; } @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); } 50% { transform: scale(1.05); } } .fab { display: none; position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 20px; z-index: 150; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold), #a8841a); color: rgb(255, 255, 255); border-width: medium; border-style: none; border-color: currentcolor; border-image: none; border-radius: 50%; width: 76px; height: 76px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 0px 6px 20px; line-height: 1.2; } @media (max-width: 768px) { .fab { display: block; } } .modal { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); z-index: 200; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 15px; } .modal.open { display: flex; } .modal-content { background: rgb(255, 255, 255); padding: 28px; border-radius: 18px; width: 100%; max-width: 480px; max-height: 92vh; overflow-y: auto; } .add-form input, .add-form select, .add-form textarea { width: 100%; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 13px; border: 1.5px solid rgb(221, 221, 221); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-family: inherit; outline: none; } .add-form input:focus, .add-form select:focus { border-color: var(--green); } .add-form label { font-weight: bold; color: var(--green-d); display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 14px; } .file-box { border: 2px dashed var(--green); border-radius: 10px; padding: 18px; text-align: center; margin-bottom: 13px; background: rgb(242, 248, 244); cursor: pointer; color: var(--green-d); font-size: 14px; } .file-box:hover { background: rgb(230, 242, 234); } .preview-img { width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; margin-bottom: 13px; display: none; } footer { background: var(--green-d); color: rgb(200, 216, 205); text-align: center; padding: 35px 5%; margin-top: 40px; font-size: 14px; } footer .disc { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); border-radius: 12px; padding: 15px; max-width: 650px; margin: 0px auto 18px; line-height: 1.9; } footer a { color: var(--gold-l); } ------MultipartBoundary--f3Ua2qQDU9Pjp4q5qkNpnhxtGZ17B11qjW3motpreE------
